project_description: Add runtime, A-leg-scoped administrator routing overrides that replace the effective client model selector for all subsequent turns until changed or cleared. Overrides are revisioned latest-wins state, take effect only for turns admitted after the committed update, never mutate in-flight turns or B-legs, preserve the full existing selector language including aliases, failover, weighted routing, races, affinity, TTFT and [thinker]/[first] modes, survive generation reload and follow continuity-store durability, and expose a protected set/replace/get/clear operator API without requiring client disconnect or proxy restart.
